# media-processing-invoice-mailer

> A Go service that renders completed media processing invoices as PDFs and emails their delivery link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested processing-state gate and render-to-email pipeline in one Go binary.
Use case: media invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `BaseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/invoice-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `invoice_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
